requirements.title: Application drawings
requirements.description: Applicants shall submit site plans and building drawings with a permit application.

requirements.title: Application charge
requirements.description: Applicants shall pay the permit filing charge by debit or credit card.

requirements.title: Site visit booking
requirements.description: Applicants shall book a site inspection slot with a municipal inspector.

requirements.title: Decision notifications
requirements.description: Applicants shall receive an email when the permit application status changes.

requirements.title: Public permit register
requirements.description: Visitors shall search issued permits by street address.

requirements.title: Refusal appeal
requirements.description: Applicants may appeal a refused permit within 21 days of the decision.

requirements.title: Inspection evidence
requirements.description: Inspectors shall attach photographs and notes to the inspection record.

requirements.title: Supervisor sign-off
requirements.description: A supervisor must approve an application before its permit is issued.

requirements.title: Permit renewal
requirements.description: Holders shall request renewal before a permit expires.

requirements.title: Change history
requirements.description: The system shall record who changed an application and when.

queries.message: Can builders send blueprints from a phone when filing?
Give rejected applicants a month to challenge the decision.
A permit must never be released until a manager signs it.
Remove the address lookup for members of the public.
Could someone extend a permit after it has already run out? We are only exploring the idea.
When the site visit is reserved, send the applicant a confirmation email.
During the booked inspection, let the officer upload photos of the site.
The clerk should verify the plan upload and card payment before sending the file for supervisor sign-off.
Add an interactive map of public toilets.
Could the city website use the new council colour palette?

requirements.title: Container temperature log
requirements.description: A sensor shall record each refrigerated container's temperature every five minutes.

requirements.title: Warm-container warning
requirements.description: Dispatchers shall receive an alert when a container exceeds 8 C for ten minutes.

requirements.title: Driver route
requirements.description: Drivers shall view their assigned delivery route on a map.

requirements.title: Receiver signature
requirements.description: The receiver shall sign to confirm delivery of the shipment.

requirements.title: Drop-off photograph
requirements.description: Drivers shall photograph each package at the drop-off location.

requirements.title: Vaccine lot ledger
requirements.description: The system shall track vaccine lot identifiers and their expiry dates.

requirements.title: Temperature-excursion hold
requirements.description: A shipment affected by a temperature excursion must be quarantined until quality staff release it.

requirements.title: Weekly temperature export
requirements.description: Operations staff shall export weekly container temperature logs as CSV.

requirements.title: Driver sign-in
requirements.description: Drivers shall log in with an employee identifier and PIN.

requirements.title: Refrigeration servicing
requirements.description: Fleet staff shall record monthly service of truck refrigeration units.

queries.message: Text the shift lead if a cooler stays warm for ten minutes.
Do not release boxes after a cooling failure until QA clears them.
Can ops download last week's readings in a spreadsheet?
Let the driver propose a detour on the assigned itinerary.
Stop allocating medicine batches past their use-by date.
Keep the probe's readings and alert dispatch if it stays above eight degrees for ten minutes.
At the doorstep collect a receiver signature and a photograph of the package.
Use the employee PIN before opening the assigned route, and require the recipient to sign at hand-off.
Introduce a fuel-card wallet for drivers.
What music may couriers play during their shift?

requirements.title: Tenant repair requests
requirements.description: Tenants shall submit maintenance work orders through the building portal.

requirements.title: Emergency triage
requirements.description: Emergency work orders shall be classified within fifteen minutes.

requirements.title: Technician assignment
requirements.description: A property manager shall assign each work order to a technician.

requirements.title: Repair appointments
requirements.description: Tenants shall choose an available repair appointment slot.

requirements.title: Appointment texts
requirements.description: Tenants shall receive SMS messages when a repair appointment changes.

requirements.title: Spare-part inventory
requirements.description: The system shall track available replacement parts for building repairs.

requirements.title: Before-and-after evidence
requirements.description: Technicians shall upload photographs before and after a repair.

requirements.title: Large repair approval
requirements.description: A landlord must approve repairs costing more than 500 dollars before work begins.

requirements.title: Damage billing
requirements.description: The manager shall bill a tenant for damage the tenant caused.

requirements.title: Monthly repair summary
requirements.description: Managers shall download a monthly PDF of repair counts and completion times.

queries.message: Residents need to report a leaking pipe through the portal.
Flag a burst water main as urgent within five minutes.
Make the owner sign off on expensive repairs over four hundred dollars.
Only use photos taken after the repair; stop taking an initial picture.
Could we include average completion time in the monthly management document?
When a tenant reschedules the repair slot, send an SMS update.
Assign the plumber and reserve the replacement valve from the stockroom.
Let a tenant file a damage report through the portal and charge them if the damage was their fault.
Add a parcel locker reservation screen to the lobby portal.
Publish the building's recycling calendar on the homepage.

requirements.title: Card ticket sales
requirements.description: Attendees shall purchase event tickets with a payment card.

requirements.title: QR admission
requirements.description: Door staff shall scan a ticket QR code to admit an attendee.

requirements.title: Cancellation refunds
requirements.description: Attendees may receive a refund when cancelling more than 48 hours before the event.

requirements.title: Seat selection
requirements.description: Attendees shall choose an available numbered seat.

requirements.title: Accessible seating
requirements.description: The venue shall reserve accessible seats for attendees who need them.

requirements.title: Ticket confirmation
requirements.description: The system shall email a ticket receipt after purchase.

requirements.title: Capacity waitlist
requirements.description: When an event is full, visitors may join a waitlist for an open place.

requirements.title: Staff permissions
requirements.description: Organizers shall grant door, finance, or manager roles to staff.

requirements.title: Daily sales sheet
requirements.description: Finance staff shall export daily ticket-sales totals as CSV.

requirements.title: Ticket transfer
requirements.description: An attendee shall transfer a valid ticket to another named person.

queries.message: Let guests hand their admission pass to a friend by changing the named holder.
Issue the money back when a guest cancels two days ahead of the show.
Door volunteers should read the QR square to let people inside.
Stop reserving step-free places for visitors with mobility needs.
Could we allow patrons to pick their numbered chair during booking?
Once card payment succeeds, email the buyer their ticket receipt.
Give the finance team access to the daily sales spreadsheet.
When a show sells out, put a guest on the queue and email them if a numbered seat opens.
Add a live translation channel for the keynote.
Can the venue display tomorrow's weather at the entrance?
